notes_html:
How the SD-Turbo strength was picked

Strength is how much noise is added to the render before the single denoising step. The pick was made on 6 training clips that are not in the test set, by a rule fixed before looking: judge realism (out of 10) × mouth correlation. Strength 0.25 won (it keeps the lips but barely changes the look); 0.75 looks the most photographic but swaps the person and loses the lips. Test-set numbers for every strength are shown so nothing is hidden.

The last row is the fine-tuned model's exact wiring with no trained weights; it gives false-colour mush and was not sent to the test-set judge. Speed: SD-Turbo numbers were both measured on one RTX 4090 (no RTX 5090 was available; the fine-tuned model measured 21.3 ms on a 5090 earlier). Wan numbers were both measured on one RTX PRO 4500. Fine-tuning does not change speed, because the LoRA is merged into the weights. The Wan runs, base and fine-tuned alike, use the public CausVid 6-step sampler add-on, which is not our training.
